body.intro:
The Deluxe Version comes with bonus story content and adult scenes. Who will you choose? Meimei or Noa?

"SuccuSeka: Resist Succubus Temptation Global Version" is a succubus visual novel with multiple endings. You can play bonus story content in the form of "Another Story" from the title screen.

Our game is broadly divided into two routes. Since you will be presented with choices at several points, you must choose your fate. The choices you make will dramatically effect the course and the length of your adventure. Will you succumb to succubus temptation or resist and save the world? Enjoy exploring all of the routes! (A special surprise awaits you after each one!)

Concept 1: A thrilling heroic fantasy with an erotic succubus twist!
Enjoy a story that intertwines two threads: one, a thrilling heroic fantasy where you save the world, and the other, an inescapable erotic twist where succubi dominate you and train you in the ways of pleasure.

Concept 2: Will you resist or succumb, become a hero or a toy?
Succubi will seduce you mercilessly. At times, they will even try to overwhelm you with pleasure using their special abilities. As the player, you can decided whether to become the hero who saves the world or a toy for the succubi to play with.

Concept 3: A world under succubus control!
Surely, the succubi will show you true happiness. Once you succumb to their temptation, you will never be the same as you fall deeper and deeper under their spell.

Our expansive story provides hours of thrilling and titillating gameplay. As the hero Ray and his childhood friend Meimei are exploring ancient ruins in a remote area of their island home, the two are suddenly enveloped in an otherworldly light. When they come to, they find themselves in an eerily deserted town. Soon, they cross paths with someone not quite human—an indecently dressed woman with wings and a tail. What will become of them after meeting a succubus...?

Meimei

The Martial Artist and Childhood Friend

An honest young woman who's full of life. Brave and optimistic, most find her agreeably straightforward. She also works hard, never neglecting her studies, and is a formidable fighter thanks to her mastery of the martial arts. She's in love with the hero, but is shy about expressing her feelings.

The Church Priestess

A delicate, air-headed maiden who perpetually looks sleepy. She has a little brother and has coddled him since childhood. Although she's blessed with an amazing body, she remains oblivious to how her incredibly large chest drives the men around her crazy. She doesn't care about glances from the opposite sex and is uninterested in romance, too.

The Innkeeper

A woman who never loses her composure. She possesses both the moxie and skill to run an inn on her own, and her attentiveness is first-rate. Her skill as a cook has caused many to fall in love with her, but she's a devoted wife and mother.
